messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - hosted-runtime reported repeated OOMs from kv-cache while serving long prompts. Error spike started ~5m ago, affected 3 customer orgs. Alerting oncall. :rotating_light:

sara_oncall: Saw the page, I'm on it. Which pools are flaring?

miguel_infra: Looks like pooled-hosted-1 and -3. kv_cache memory growth correlates with a burst of 50k token prompts from a single tenant, continuous batching amplified it.

alyssa_runtime: Confirmed. We have runaway prefix growth - continuous batching holding large KV windows and prefetch bringing in huge context. JVM/agent logs show repeated serialize failures then OOM.

calvin_sre: Any immediate mitigation we can apply without full rollback? Can we throttle prefetch or reduce batch_window?

miguel_infra: We can flip a temporary throttle on prefetch for hosted pools and reduce max_batch_tokens to 2048. Patch is low-risk, requires config rollout to two autoscale groups.

ops-manager: Prioritize mitigation. Customer-ops, notify affected customers about degraded latency and potential 500s.

customer-ops: Notifying now. Initial note: "We're investigating increased errors and latency for long-context requests. Mitigating now, ETA 30-45m."

 sara_oncall: Doing the config change on pooled-hosted-1 first. @miguel_infra can you stage the policy?

miguel_infra: Pushing policy now. Command: ```
# set prefetch throttle to conservative
rwcctl runtime config set --pool pooled-hosted-1 --kv-prefetch-rate 0.2 --max-batch-tokens 2048 --dry-run=false
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-change-1943219876 -> pooled-hosted-1 (3 instances)

calvin_sre: Watch logs for eviction churn and request queueing. I'll open a temporary dashboard.

alyssa_runtime: rolled to pooled-hosted-1, observing immediate drop in memory growth. Latency for long prompts spiked ~200ms while draining, but OOMs stopped. Moving to pooled-hosted-3 next.

miguel_infra: Pushed to pooled-hosted-3: ```rwcctl runtime config set --pool pooled-hosted-3 --kv-prefetch-rate 0.2 --max-batch-tokens 2048```

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: config-change-1943219876 -> pooled-hosted-3

 sara_oncall: Good. All obvious OOM alerts suppressed. Any downstream customer 500s resolving?

customer-ops: Customers reporting fewer 500s, some are seeing higher latencies for requests >30k tokens. We're following up.

calvin_sre: We need a protective rule: reject requests exceeding model_max_context or route them to dedicated capacity in the meantime. Otherwise prefetch + batching will keep causing amplification.

alyssa_runtime: Agreed. I can push a temporary upper bound on allowed context length for hosted runtime: 65k tokens. Longer requests get HTTP 429 with guidance. Low-risk and quick.

miguel_infra: Also adding an automatic fallback: when kv_cache resident memory > 85% of pool limit, route new long-context requests to a low-prefetch fallback model variant. Implementing now.

 sara_oncall: Implement both. Commands: ```
# add context length guard
rwcctl runtime guard add --type context-length --pool hosted --max-tokens 65000 --response-code 429 --message "Request exceeds hosted max context; contact sales for dedicated capacity"
# add memory-based routing
rwcctl routing set --pool hosted --policy "if kv_mem_pct>85 then route:hosted-fallback-low-prefetch"
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: context-guard-1943219876 -> hosted-control-plane

ops-manager: Good call. Customer impact seems contained; elevating to investigatory incident. Please capture sequence, ids, and telemetry for postmortem.

miguel_infra: Telemetry notes: epoch spike in avg_request_tokens per user, continuous batching window size jumped x4 due to client batching pattern. Prefetch brought in entire context; kv_cache couldn't evict fast enough -> OOM.

calvin_sre: For next 48h, enable extended KV eviction and more aggressive prefetch backoff on hosted pools. Also add alert: sustained kv_evictions > 500/min per pool.

alyssa_runtime: Will open rollout PR for prefetch backoff and eviction tuning. Marking it high priority.

 sara_oncall: Handoff time in 20m to @miguel_infra for daytime ops. I'm leaving notes here and linking dashboards.

miguel_infra: Taking over. Will keep the conservative throttles until we validate longer-term fixes. Please add customer request sampling so we can replay offending long prompts in sandbox.

customer-ops: Customers want root cause and ETA for full fix. We told them we'll follow up with timeline after triage.

 ops-manager: Action items: 1) Postmortem with timeline and mitigations 2) Backoff + eviction PR 3) Context-length guard permanent policy or dedicated capacity guidance 4) Customer RCA note. Assigned: alyssa, miguel, calvin, customer-ops.

 sara_oncall: Leaving: incident acked, mitigations in place, no active OOMs, watchlist open. :thumbsup:

miguel_infra: Logged follow-up ticket INF-1287 for replay tooling and tenant-level rate limits. Will update here with progress.

calvin_sre: I'll keep the alerting thresholds and escalate if we see re-escalation.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: context-guard-1943219876 -> hosted-control-plane

ops-manager: Thanks team. We'll schedule a 1hr post-incident review tomorrow.

miguel_infra: Noted. Closing the immediate page; moving to follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident 3892 -> status: mitigated. Follow-ups created: INF-1287, RCT-452.

customer-ops: Final customer update sent: "Mitigation applied; we implemented request limits for extremely long prompts and are working on a permanent configuration change. We'll share a full RCA within 48 hours."

 sara_oncall: thread closed from my side. Back to standby.
